name_reason: Conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with a datatype-reflecting _table suffix; no Ghidra address residue. 'no_money' accurately names the 'can't afford' reject prompt, 'dialog_text_id' names the FDTXT page-id content. The doubled 'dialog' (domain + descriptor) is shared by every sibling table in dlgtab.c (buy_for/no_equip/auto_equip/sell_for/...); renaming for that cosmetic redundancy alone would break naming consistency across the table family and is not warranted.
purpose: Per-shop-tier FDTXT dialog page text-id table for the 'can't afford' reject prompt shown when party gold is below the item price in the chapter-intro shop BUY flow.
logic_summary: short[6] indexed by the shop-tier radio state data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state (0..5). Sole reader fd2_run_buy_item_menu @ 0x2f0b0 block-copies the 12 bytes into a 12-byte stack-local buffer up front, then -- only on the affordability-failure branch (data_fd2_shared_party_total_gold < (int)current_item_price, a signed compare) -- reads the entry back as a signed 16-bit word (*(short *)(buf + cursor_state*2 + -4); the -4 compensates for the stack_save split) and passes it as the FDTXT page id to fd2_display_dialog_scene. Buy-only: the give-item flow has no price check, so this table has exactly one reader.
element_semantics: FDTXT dialog page text-id (signed 16-bit) for the 'can't afford' prompt at shop tier = index (cursor_state 0..5). Values: {0x0001, 0x01F8, 0x0001, 0x01B6, 0x0001, 0x01B6}; 0x0001 placeholder/no-op tier, 0x01F8/0x01B6 are real FDTXT page ids per tier.
notes: Memory at 0x52706 (12 bytes LE) = 0100f8010100b6010100b601 = {0x0001,0x01F8,0x0001,0x01B6,0x0001,0x01B6}, byte-identical to the src definition (line 87). xrefs_to: only fd2_run_buy_item_menu (READ @ 0x2f0da + DATA @ 0x2f0d5); no writers -> const confirmed. Decompile of the reader confirms 6-element int16 stride, signed (*(short *)) read, signed affordability compare, and single buy-only reader. Existing src comment block (lines 68-88) already states all of this precisely as a final conclusion (no process/phase log) -> comment kept. No data plate exists for this address in Ghidra (data plates live in src per project convention); the reader function's own plate already documents [0x52706]; nothing contradicts src -> plate left untouched. Name kept; any rename for the sibling-wide doubled-'dialog' redundancy is deferred to Stage 2 only if the whole family is renamed together, which is out of scope here.
